messages:
Laura K: Quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/14820 needs final approvals but the macOS matrix is flaky right now. Can we avoid landing before the freeze unless we get a clean rerun? :eyes:
Sandeep: Assigning reviewers @Jason @Olivia. Fail looks isolated to `mac-11` and `mac-12` UI tests. Short log below:
```
--- FAIL: TestRenderWidget (0.12s)
stack: ui/renderer_test.go:134: element not found: .toast
error: timeout waiting for selector
```
Jason: I'll take a look. If it's only mac runners we might be able to rerun just that matrix. Can you repro locally @Sandeep?
Olivia: I can give an LGTM after green. If the rerun keeps flaking, we should consider postponing until after the deploy freeze (no merges during 2025-11-20 -> 2025-11-23 per Release Bot).
Release Bot: Reminder: deploy blackout scheduled 2025-11-20 00:00 UTC through 2025-11-23 06:00 UTC. Plan merges accordingly.
Tasha: What's our rebase-window policy currently? I thought larger PRs get a 2hr rebase window before freeze? Want to avoid a half-merged canary.
Sandeep: Policy reminder — small fixes get 1h, medium 2h, large/DB 4h; but if CI is noisy we prefer to wait for a stable run. Plan: 1) try a rebase to main, 2) run `/ci run mac-matrix` (only the mac jobs), 3) if still flaky mark `hold/after-freeze` and schedule for the next post-freeze slot.
Laura K: Sounds good. I'm fine with postponing if it doesn't go green in two reruns. @CI Bot can you prioritize a mac-only rerun for this PR after a rebase? :pray:
CI Bot: Rerun scheduled: `ci.rerun --pr 14820 --jobs mac-11,mac-12` — queued on mac pool. ETA ~8m.
Jason: Quick note — there was a small change in the browser shim merged to main that could affect the selector timing. I'll add a tiny wait in the test before we rerun.
Sandeep: I pushed a rebase and test tweak just now, triggered the mac-only rerun. Ping if it flakes again and I'll mark as `hold/after-freeze`.
Laura K: Thanks — pinged @Olivia for final LGTM once green.
CI Bot: mac-11: ✅, mac-12: ✅ — all mac jobs green. Merging will proceed in 5m unless a release hold is applied.
Olivia: LGTM, approving now. :shipit:
Laura K: Merging now. Thanks everyone for the quick turn. If anything odd appears post-merge we can rollback to the previous canary.
